newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Bank says discussing Sri Dhana stake.
newsitem.headline: DBS Bank says discussing Sri Dhana stake.

text.p: DBS Bank said on Thursday it had held discussions with the Srivikorn family regarding its position in Thailand's Sri Dhana Finance & Securities, but denied it was discussing a merger.
DBS said in a statement the discussions were "exploratory" and "may or may not lead to further development".
It said the statement was issued in response to a report in Singapore's Business Times, which quoted a senior official at the Thai firm as saying DBS and Sri Dhana were considering a merger.

"In view of the recent developments in the banking and finance sector in Thailand, DBC Bank has had discussions with the Srivikorn family regarding its position and role in Sri Dhana Finance & Securities, and not a merger, as reported," the statement said.
"DBS is continually looking for opportunities in Singapore and elsewhere, including Thailand as part of its business development efforts," it added.
Sri Dhana, in which DBS holds a 10 percent stake, was one of 10 finance companies ordered by the Bank of Thailand last month to raise provisions for sub-standard assets and increase its capital.
